fields.name: iconCenterPane

fields.name: iconRightPane

summary: Graphics render state cache: maintains a red-black tree (std::map) of state blocks and tracks the last applied state and variant ID to avoid emitting duplicate commands to the command buffer.
evidence: Manipulated in Gfx_StateCache_EmitStateBlock (0x0055FC5C) called from Gfx_CmdList_BindTexture (0x0055CAD4) to emit cached PICA GPU state blocks.

fields.name: stateTreeHeader
fields.evidence: Address of std::map header/sentinel node at self+0x14; used as tree end boundary in Gfx_StateCache_EmitStateBlock (0x0055FC5C).

fields.name: stateTreeRoot
fields.evidence: Root node pointer of the red-black tree storing state blocks keyed by integer in Gfx_StateCache_EmitStateBlock (0x0055FC5C).

fields.name: cachedVariantId
fields.evidence: Cached state variant/tag ID compared against node->f_30 and updated to node->f_30 in Gfx_StateCache_EmitStateBlock (0x0055FC5C) to select state block copy size.

fields.name: lastAppliedState
fields.evidence: Pointer to the last applied state block/node; compared against lookup result iVar2 in Gfx_StateCache_EmitStateBlock (0x0055FC5C) to skip redundant command buffer emissions.

summary: Field actor / mount effect playback state controller: holds a 0x6C-byte parameter/transform block at +0x26C and reset/restart flags at +0x2C8 and +0x2F4 cleared and re-raised on movement state transitions.

fields.name: paramBlock
fields.evidence: Start of 0x6C-byte transform/parameter sub-block initialized to default values via func_0017D0DC in Gfx_EffectSlot_ResetPlayback (0x00366910).

fields.name: isPlaybackRestartRequested
fields.evidence: Boolean flag at +0x2C8 set to 1 in Gfx_EffectSlot_ResetPlayback (0x00366910) when movement/animation resets.

fields.name: isResetPending
fields.evidence: Boolean flag at +0x2F4 set to 1 in Gfx_EffectSlot_ResetPlayback (0x00366910) alongside +0x2C8 when playback state is reset.

summary: Graphics resource handle / resource container: stores resource ID at +0x04, state/allocator at +0x08 (invalidated to -1 upon release), and maintains an active resource list head at +0xD74 for acquired sprite/animation bank resources.

fields.name: resourceId

fields.name: handleId
fields.evidence: Handle/state index invalidated to -1 in maybe_Gfx_ResourceHandle_Release (0x001F15E0); also used as allocator pointer at owner+8 in maybe_Gfx_ResourceHandle_AcquireType1 (0x001C8704).

fields.name: activeResourceList
fields.evidence: Linked list (std::list) head at owner+0xD74 where acquired sprite/animation bank resources are inserted via func_001235A4 in maybe_Gfx_ResourceHandle_AcquireType1 (0x001C8704) and AcquireType2 (0x001C87CC).

summary: Screen view management container: manages three per-screen collections: 16 quick-view entries at +0x00, 32 screen view slot entries (0x1C bytes each) at +0x100 with fade flags, and 36 scene entries (0x2C bytes each) at +0x480.

fields.name: sceneEntries
